verdict.rationale: Jan ships no client libraries of its own. It does document that its local server is OpenAI-compatible and works as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, and that Anthropic SDK clients can be pointed at its /v1/messages endpoint. That lets developers call it from existing Python/JavaScript SDKs, but those SDKs belong to other vendors, and the docs give only curl examples. Missing for 10: first-party Python/JavaScript client libraries, language-specific SDK code examples, an OpenAPI spec for generating clients, independent corroboration of SDK usage.
